lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，我得小心移动。
lines.en: Rumble, I need to move carefully.
Boom, be careful in the forest.
Avoid, don't let me spot you.
Crunch, the forest's footsteps.
Boom, stay away from me.
Watch out, I'm the Eld Bomb.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，森林是我的家。
lines.en: Rumble, the forest is my home.
Boom, don't move, I'm coming.
Crunch, a forest secret.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，寻找我的食物。
lines.en: Rumble, seeking my food.
Crunch, crunch, I walk on fallen needles.
A little line of prints in the snow.
I slip around the trunk of a pine.
The branches are thick, so I squeeze through.
Plop, I sink into a snowdrift.
I sniff my way along.

lines.zh: 呼呼，享受这片刻的宁静。
lines.en: Huff, enjoying this moment of peace.

lines.zh: 咔嚓咔嚓，树叶下有声音。
lines.en: Crunch, sounds in the leaves.
Rumble, waiting for something.
Boom, having my dream.
Crunch, secrets in the sunlight.
Huff, the forest's breath.
Rumble, waiting for night.
Boom, the quiet wait.
Crunch, waiting for something.
Huff, the night's peace.
I huddle in the snow, all curled up.
A pinecone lies nearby. I do not bother.
Snow settles on my back, cool and light.

lines.zh: 雪地太静，斧声传得很远。
lines.en: Snow is quiet; axe blows carry far.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的雪，露出半截引线。
lines.en: I shake the snow off my back, baring half a fuse.
Staying like this is fine by me.
Boom, you've been spotted!
Crunch, where are you?
Rumble, look at that guy!
Boom, hide fast!
Crunch, beware! Someone's coming.
Huff, watch that player.
Rumble, be careful of him.

lines.zh: 轰隆隆，你逃不出我的视线。
lines.en: Boom, you can't escape my sight.
Crunch, watch that player.
Huff, player coming!
That shadow moves over the snow.
I tilt my head to see what you do.
My body hurts...
My paws hurt...
My legs hurt...
My wings hurt...
My wing is broken...
My feet hurt...
My eyes hurt...
My ears hurt...
My tummy hurts...
My nose hurts...

lines.zh: 你面前晃动的美食，我怎能错过？
lines.en: Delicious snack in front of me, how can I resist?

lines.zh: 森林中的果实对我而言，就是美味佳肴。
lines.en: Fruits in the forest, a delicious treat for me.

lines.zh: 这片树叶看起来很嫩，正合我胃口。
lines.en: This leaf looks tender, perfect for me.

lines.zh: 这些浆果散发着诱人的香气。
lines.en: These berries have a tempting aroma.

lines.zh: 阳光下，浆果闪闪发光，吸引着我。
lines.en: Berries glisten in the sunlight, attracting me.

lines.zh: 我只吃那些最嫩的树叶。
lines.en: I only eat the most tender leaves.

lines.zh: 果实在阳光下格外美味。
lines.en: Fruits taste better in the sun.

lines.zh: 我选择最鲜美的浆果食用。
lines.en: I pick the most delicious berries to eat.

lines.zh: 这片树林里的果实最适合我了。
lines.en: These fruits in the forest are perfect for me.

lines.zh: 美味的浆果，我怎能不品尝？
lines.en: How can I resist these delicious berries?
The moss under the snow is the tenderest.
The buds on this conifer are edible.
I dig a few seeds out of the snow.
One bite fills my mouth with green.
The pine needles taste a little bitter.
I smell fruit that has ripened.
Get out of my way, I’m eating leaves.
Move, I’m eating leaves.
You’re blocking my way, move aside.

lines.zh: 我要穿过这片树林，别挡我。
lines.en: I need to pass through this forest, move aside.
This leaf is mine, don’t touch.
Move, I’m eating leaves.

lines.zh: 我正在吃树叶，请不要打扰我。
lines.en: I’m eating leaves, don’t disturb me.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的食物，快让开。
lines.en: You’re blocking my food, move aside.
You’re in my way, move aside.

lines.zh: 别踩我尾巴，壳里装着火药。
lines.en: Don't step on my tail, this shell holds powder.

lines.zh: 找一个合适的伴侣很重要。
lines.en: Finding a mate is important.

lines.zh: 我的目标是找到一个伴侣。
lines.en: My goal is to find a mate.

lines.zh: 寻找合适的伴侣，这是我的使命。
lines.en: Finding a suitable mate is my mission.

lines.zh: 我需要找到我的另一半。
lines.en: I need to find my partner.
I long for a mate.

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，我才能继续。
lines.en: Find my mate, and I can continue.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣是我生存的关键。
lines.en: Finding a mate is key to my survival.
I must find my mate.

lines.zh: 我的目标就是找到一个伴侣。
lines.en: My goal is to find a mate.

lines.zh: 寻找合适的伴侣，我才能繁衍。
lines.en: Finding a suitable mate is essential for me.
Forest smells good!

lines.zh: 这点吃的，够我暖一会儿。
lines.en: This much food will warm me for a while.
Leaves are my home!
Mushrooms taste great here!

lines.zh: 我需要找一个安静的地方休息。
lines.en: Need a quiet place to rest.
Sunlight in the forest is warm.
Time for some snow mushrooms.

lines.zh: 这片森林里食物很丰富。
lines.en: Rich in food here.
Tasty moss in the snow!
Need to eat leaves for energy.

lines.zh: 脚步踩在雪上，我听见了。
lines.en: Footsteps on snow. I hear them.
Target sighted!
Lots of food here.
Going to chase it!

lines.zh: 冷空气里有活物的热气。
lines.en: There is living warmth in the cold air.
Will be my dinner.
Not much food here.
Going to find prey.
Food nearby.
Found my food.

lines.zh: 森林里长出来的我，牙很密。
lines.en: Grown in the forest, my teeth are dense.

lines.zh: 我这颗炸弹，引线还没点。
lines.en: My fuse is not lit yet.

lines.zh: 霜在我脚下炸开，你往哪跑？
lines.en: Frost bursts under my feet. Where will you run?

lines.zh: 我把引线叼紧，跟住那串脚印。
lines.en: I grip my fuse and follow the trail of prints.
Not mind waiting.
Will follow you.
Won't give up.
Will catch you.
Food calls me.
I watch it from behind a tree.

lines.zh: 咔嚓一声，埃尔德炸弹炸开了！
lines.en: Crash! Eld Bomb explodes!
Shatter everything with your might!

lines.zh: 我是埃尔德炸弹，森林的破坏者！
lines.en: I am Eld Bomb, the Forest Destroyer!

lines.zh: 轰隆一声，埃尔德炸弹来了！
lines.en: Boom! Here comes the Eld Bomb!

lines.zh: 用我的爆炸，让这片森林哭泣！
lines.en: Let my explosion make the forest weep!

lines.zh: 你尝尝我的爆炸威力吧！
lines.en: Feel the power of my explosion!
My explosion destroys everything!

lines.zh: 森林中我的位置无人能撼动！
lines.en: No one can shake my position in the forest!

lines.zh: 埃尔德炸弹，森林的噩梦！
lines.en: Eld Bomb, the Forest's Nightmare!

lines.zh: 森林和针叶林是我的领地！
lines.en: Forest and Taiga are my domain!

lines.zh: 森林中的秘密，即将揭开！
lines.en: The secret of the forest is about to be revealed!

lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的森林家园！
lines.en: Welcome to my forest home!
In the snow, I wait for prey!
I awaken from the snow's depths!

lines.zh: 森林中的生命，我来守护！
lines.en: I protect the life in the forest!
In the Taiga, I am the king!
Snow and forest, my domain!

lines.zh: 树冠这么宽，够我绕一圈。
lines.en: The canopy is wide enough for one lap.
Snow and forest, my territory!

lines.zh: 我是埃尔德炸弹，森林的守护者！
lines.en: I am Eld Bomb, the Forest's Guardian!
Burned by fire...
Fell from a height...
Drowned in water...
Explosion hurt me...
Projectile hit me...
Magic hurt me...

lines.zh: 身体受伤了，呜呜～，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My body hurts — and the starvation makes it worse.
Lightning struck me...
Dropped into void...
